enforce-lease.mechanism: Role skills state the intended write scope. Codex's own sandbox, approvals, and tool permissions remain authoritative.

block-dangerous.mechanism: System2 skills tell the agent to avoid destructive commands; Codex applies its own command policy.

protect-sensitive.mechanism: System2 skills tell the agent to avoid secrets and sensitive paths unless the user explicitly requests access.

format.mechanism: Role skills require formatting edited files before completion.

typecheck.mechanism: Role skills require relevant type checks before completion.

budget.mechanism: Role skills require a concise completion summary with files touched and change size.
